title: Phone screen row that steps one card per beat
summary: A row of tall phone-screen cards on a light-to-grey floor glides left one card pitch about every 2.15 s: a fast eased slide, then a slow creep. One continuous move tours many screens with no cuts.
use_when: Touring 6-10 mobile app screens in one silent loop
A product page hero or social loop where screenshots carry the message
A feature-tour beat inside a longer mobile launch film
A calm, minimal brand voice with no VO and no SFX

look.type_style: small regular grotesk label top-left on each card, sentence case, about 2.8 % of H, white; tiny mono labels in a footer row, about 1.2 % of H

structure.motion: slide 85 % of pitch, easings.inOutSine 22 fr (±0.25 s), then easings.linear creep ~15 % pitch over 30 fr

params.brand: brand.json: bg (light top), fg, muted for the floor gradient, mono for the footer, logo for cards and footer
params.content.screens: 6-10 screenshots in phone aspect (~0.46 w/h), one per card
params.content.labels: one short label per card, 1-3 words, top-left
params.content.footer: up to 3 tiny mono labels in the footer row ('' = none)
params.timing.period: frames between step starts (default 65 = 2.15 s at 30 fps)
params.timing.creep: share of the pitch covered by the slow creep (default 0.15)
params.layout.cardWidth: card width as share of W (default 0.29)
params.layout.pitch: card pitch as share of W (default 0.39)
params.aspect: 4:5 | 1:1 | 9:16 | 16:9; card height ~50 % of H, row centred at 50 % H

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s, no 30 fps strip). Zero cuts in one 12.87 s shot; rows split at each step start. Step starts 0.27, 2.27, 4.50, 6.77, 8.77, 11.00 s (period 2.0-2.27, mean 2.15 s); each moves ~85 % of the pitch in ~22 fr with the peak in the middle (inOut profile), the rest is a slow creep (~185 px/s at 1920 W from motion.json in the quiet seconds vs ~400-500 px/s in step seconds). Card 324x705 px at 1120x1400, radius ~24 px, pitch 436 px, top at 25 % H; a hairline divides each card at mid height. Cards in the reference are empty placeholders. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term step-carousel (recipe.md), not in recipe.json. Catalogue hints horizon-arc, mask-wipe, slide-push were not seen in any cell.
